title: skill-selection
description: Selection policy of one skill, kept in `selection.json` beside its `SKILL.md` so that the frontmatter stays within the Agent Skills standard (whose `metadata` is a string-to-string map). Read by `skiller registry` into `skills.json` (`selection`) and by `skiller select`; a skill without the file is `kind: domain` with no triggers.

kind.description: What the skill is for: `contract` a rule or deliverable format, `procedure` steps to follow, `domain` knowledge of a stack or area, `tool` use of a tool or capability, `router` a choice between other skills, `reference` material read on request, `persona` a role voice.

decision.description: Decision of the skill audit (first code of the audit decision): keep, slim, split, merge, hand over to the router only, make a reference, replace with a script, a project overlay, an orchestration workflow, a package-local skill, a persona, deprecate or delete; `ARTIFACT`, `COMMAND`, `SCHEMA`, `CONTRACT`, `CONFIG`, `POLICY`, `TOOL_PROFILE` and `EXTERNAL_PACK` name where the content moves.

also.description: Further codes of a compound audit decision, such as `SLIM` of `KEEP/SLIM`.

roles.description: Orchestration roles that take the skill as required, such as `reviewer`; empty or absent means no role requires it.

triggers.description: What in a project makes the skill relevant.

requires_tools.description: Tools or capabilities a role must have for the skill to be useful; a role without them does not get the skill.

conflicts.description: Skills that must not be selected together with this one.

exclusive_group.description: Group of the table `skiller/configs/exclusive-groups.json` whose members are not selected together beyond the group limit.

max_tokens.description: Token budget of the skill body that selection counts; selection does not cut the text.

replaced_by.description: Where the content lives now: a role contract, a schema, a hook or a script; the skill is not preloaded for orchestration roles.

eval_report.description: Path of the eval report that backs the decision, or null when there is none.

verified_at.description: Date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) the decision was last checked, or null.
